# Vacancy research: 336 Adeline St, Oakland

**APN:** 004-0027-014-00  
**Verdict:** unknown (confidence 0.72)  
**Vacancy start / duration:** unknown; no public evidence located establishes when a vacancy began or whether one was continuous.

The parcel is an industrial property. LoopNet reports a lease listing dated November 18, 2019, but a listing does not prove the premises became or remained vacant. A 2021 California Air Resources Board enforcement report associates Green Planet 21, Inc. dba The Sutta Company with the address; a company address likewise does not establish physical occupancy. Oakland Legistar records confirm the APN/address pairing and CIX-1B zoning, which is not occupancy evidence. Current physical occupancy therefore cannot be determined from the public evidence located.

Sources: [LoopNet property/lease history](https://www.loopnet.com/property/336-adeline-st-oakland-CA-94607/06001-004%20002701400/); [CARB 2021 annual enforcement report](https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2022-07/2021_Annual_Enforcement_Report_4.pdf); [Oakland Legistar attachment](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=DE9D9D0B-4771-4D9D-8F7E-B529062A531F&ID=15191265&M=F); [Oakland public permit-records guidance](https://www.oaklandca.gov/Planning-Building/Planning-Building-Records-Requests).
